---
title: "全历史八策略：JOINT四方案预测计划冻结"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  config: null
---

本入口是八方案研究的第一计算阶段，不读取赛果或结算SP。
复用原JOINT、先扩组后加深、U4及区分度复用实现；不能将此阶段
误称为八方案验收完成。已暴露历史诊断，历史可用性未证明。

```{r}
library(dplyr)
cfg<-jsonlite::fromJSON(params$config)
root<-cfg$repository_root
reticulate::use_python(cfg$python,required=TRUE)
modules<-c('n7_sleeve_tables','n7_joint_sleeves','n7_capital_depth',
 'n7_capital_portfolio','n7_core_opportunity','n7_sweet_union','n7_sp_filter',
 'n7_probability_replay','n7_purchase_pool','n7_purchase_exposure',
 'n7_purchase_confidence','n7_purchase_equivalence')
for(n in modules)source(file.path(root,'r',paste0(n,'.R')))
stopifnot(digest::digest(file=cfg$scope,algo='sha256')==cfg$scope_sha256)
scope<-jsonlite::fromJSON(cfg$scope)
stopifnot(scope$status=='BUNDLE_HASHES_VERIFIED',length(scope$errors)==0,
 !anyDuplicated(cfg$issues),all(cfg$issues %in% scope$issues$issue),
 !dir.exists(cfg$output))
entries<-scope$issues[match(cfg$issues,scope$issues$issue),]
code_files<-c(paste0('r/',modules,'.R'),'quarto/227_eight_strategy_joint_freeze.qmd')
code<-setNames(lapply(code_files,function(f)digest::digest(file=file.path(root,f),algo='sha256')),code_files)
api<-reticulate::import('src.strategy_diagnostic_inputs')
prov<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.provenance')
closure<-prov$implementation_closure(reticulate::import('pathlib')$Path(root),
 list('src.strategy_diagnostic_inputs','src.fundamentals_n7_baseline'),distributions=list('numpy','pandas'))
s<-cfg$settings
stopifnot(s$budget_cny==1024,s$unit_cny==2,s$payout_factor==.65)
dir.create(cfg$output,recursive=TRUE)
bindings<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(entries))) {
 e<-entries[i,]
 b<-jsonlite::fromJSON(api$read_verified_bundle_json(e$path,e$sha256),simplifyVector=FALSE)
 stopifnot(b$issue==e$issue)
 a<-n7_probability_allocate(b,b$cutoffs,'FROZEN',cfg$python,s$target_coverage,
  s$group_cap_cny,s$minimum_sp,s$budget_cny,s$unit_cny,s$payout_factor,
  s$seed,s$worlds,s$max_actions)
 plan<-list(issue=b$issue,fixtures=b$expanded_pool$fixtures,cutoffs=b$cutoffs,
  arms=list(),source_sha256=e$sha256,settings=s,code=code,
  closure_sha256=closure$closure_sha256,historical_admission=FALSE)
 for(policy in c('JOINT','DEPTH_OPEN','U4','CONFIDENCE')) {
  pool<-n7_purchase_pool(a$pool,b$cutoffs,'PROB',.05,.5,
    if(policy=='DEPTH_OPEN')as.integer(s$extra_depths) else integer())
  limits<-if(policy=='CONFIDENCE')
   n7_purchase_confidence_limits(pool,b$cutoffs,s$unit_cny,.05,2,6,128,384) else
   n7_purchase_limits(pool,b$cutoffs,s$unit_cny,if(policy=='U4')4 else Inf,Inf)
  sc<-n7_joint_returns(pool,a$worlds,b$cutoffs)
  fit<-n7_core_allocate(pool,sc,b$cutoffs,s$budget_cny,'any_hit',s$max_actions,'OPEN_FIRST',limits)
  stopifnot(fit$stop_reason!='ACTION_LIMIT')
  if(policy=='JOINT')stopifnot(all(n7_purchase_equivalence(a,list(pool=pool,fit=fit,worlds=a$worlds),b$cutoffs)))
  plan$arms[[policy]]<-list(options=pool$options[fit$selected],metrics=fit$metrics,
   stop_reason=fit$stop_reason)
 }
 plan$seal<-digest::digest(plan,algo='sha256')
 path<-file.path(cfg$output,paste0('plan-',b$issue,'.rds'))
 saveRDS(plan,path)
 bindings[[b$issue]]<-list(path=path,sha256=digest::digest(file=path,algo='sha256'),source_sha256=e$sha256)
 writeLines(paste(i,nrow(entries),b$issue),file.path(cfg$output,'progress.txt'))
 message('FROZEN ',i,'/',nrow(entries),' ',b$issue)
}
stopifnot(identical(code,setNames(lapply(code_files,function(f)digest::digest(file=file.path(root,f),algo='sha256')),code_files)))
jsonlite::write_json(list(status='FROZEN_NOT_SETTLED',config=cfg,
 bindings=bindings,code=code,closure=closure,historical_admission=FALSE),
 file.path(cfg$output,'plans-receipt.json'),pretty=TRUE,auto_unbox=TRUE,digits=NA)
```

冻结期数：`r length(bindings)`。后续独立核验、结算、四个其他方案及
完整分析报告尚须完成；本入口没有产生收益结论。
